review:
A 50-line island game where an awakening volcano throws wilds across the reels. Scatters gather like totems and unlock free spins.

In the bonus, the wilds grow and roam around the grid, so there's always something moving. Chance x2 improves your free spins odds for a slightly higher bet. Medium-high volatility, a 5,000x max and 97% RTP, with free spins about once every 227 spins.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
